messages:
josh: Heads-up — after the merge of the fused-attn reorder PR we're seeing a large p95 decode regression on long-context workloads. CI perf job flagged it (see trace link).

anya: ugh. numbers?

josh: CI job 7821 (decode-perf-suite) shows decode_p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~320ms for seq=4096 tests. Overall throughput ~1.6x lower.

ci-bot: perf-ci: job 7821 failed threshold: decode_p95 (320ms) > 200ms (baseline 120ms). Artifact: s3://perf-artifacts/7821/trace.html

rachel: I repro locally with the perf harness. Command I ran:
```
./bench --model redwood-v1 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --warm 50 --profile=trace.json
```
results: p95 ~330ms, tail latency spikes align with attention kernel switch.

rachel: profile snippets show repeated KV cache invalidations (kv_cache.miss spikes) right after attention_fused->attention_split path selection in the kernel selector log.

josh: here's the kernel selector debug dump when it flips: 
```
# kernel_selection.log
seq=4096, batch=1 -> selected_kernel: fused_attn_reorder v2
post-selection: kv_policy=EVICT_IF_FUSION mismatch=true
kv_cache.evictions=24
```

anya: So the reorder fused op triggers a different memory layout causing the KV policy's estimate to think it needs to evict more often? That would cause more memory copies and p95 spikes.

sheraz: did a quick bisect: the change that correlates is commit abcdef1 (fused-attn: reorder matmul before kv affinity). Reverting abcdef1 on top of main brings p95 back to ~125ms locally.

rachel: I also toggled the runtime flag --prefer-old-kernel and it returns to old behavior, p95 ~128ms. So kernel chooser path is the culprit, not unrelated scheduler work.

josh: Good bisect. Is this a safe revert patch for rollout? We have a canary in progress for the release.

anya: We should hold the rollout and push a focused revert. Rolling forward risks affecting customers.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused (release/2026-03-20) per manual hold by @anya.

josh: I'll open revert PR: revert/fused-attn-reorder (target: immediate hotfix). Also adding a perf test in the harness to catch kv-cache churn for seq>2048.

sheraz: Also adding a fix proposal: instead of reordering kernels globally, update KV cache estimator to account for fused layout delta so it doesn't evict prematurely. That is more surgical but slower to land.

rachel: For safety let's revert first, then ship estimator fix and a unit/perf test to validate KV stability.

ci-bot: perf-ci: triggered job 7824 for revert branch.

deploy-bot: Deployed revert/fused-attn-reorder to canary cluster canary-2. Monitoring p95.

rachel: Canary results after revert: decode_p95 dropped to 122ms, kv_cache.evictions ~1-2 per request. Looks good.

anya: OK plan: revert merged, canary promoted after 2 hours no regressions, then follow-up PR for estimator with tests. Assigning follow-up to @sheraz and @rachel.

josh: Thanks everyone — saved the rollout. I'll post a short notes item in release thread and add the perf artifacts. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to prod after monitoring window.
